changes: Only explicit previously authenticated selected module/context cache entries are staged.
Same-filesystem completed cache files use hard links; EXDEV alone permits SHA256-checked copy2.
Cache receipt bytes, cached_object paths, context keys, object companions and original source trees remain unchanged.
Static auditor prefers explicitly supplied accepted context cache entries before the global cache to obtain same-filesystem inputs.

builder_readonly_review.completed_component_branch: Reads exact receipt and cached source companion bundles, then installs only into a new run context.
builder_readonly_review.install: Checks equal bytes if destination exists; otherwise creates a new file link or EXDEV copy. Does not open imported/cache inputs for writing.
builder_readonly_review.cache_result: Creates a new staging directory and refuses to overwrite an existing completed cache key.
builder_readonly_review.compiler_outputs: Fresh attempt paths for new modules/aggregate; imported object files are read-only inputs.
builder_readonly_review.native_boundary: Hard-link staging targets only receipt and .olean/private/server/.ilean/.ir cache files, not global native shared libraries.

required_pre_use_plan: Freeze source/destination file identities, original receipt paths/key/hash and exact source/cache manifest before creating candidate cache links.
required_post_run_check: Rehash every linked/copied source and destination and original cached_object bundle after fresh aggregate/full audit.
